subject: Implementation itinerary & onboarding prep: real-time outputs + tool calls
messages:
From: Nia Brooks <nia@catalysthealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:01-07:00
Subject: Implementation itinerary: streaming -> structured outputs

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're excited to move forward with Redwood for our real-time triage feature. I've attached a spreadsheet outlining the fields we'd like in structured outputs and some sample event flows (see attachment: Customer-expected-schema.xlsx).

High-level asks:
- Streaming inference with partial/refresh updates to the UI (low-latency, <200ms per token when possible)
- Tool-calling for lookup APIs (patient lookup, policy checks) triggered from model outputs
- Structured JSON output with a strict schema (we'll validate and version on our side)

Can your CS/implementation team propose an implementation itinerary (milestones, owners, and checkpoints) and confirm any required SSO/SCIM setup for our staging environment?

We'd like a live walkthrough the week of Aug 22 — Tue/Wed mornings PST work for us.

Thanks,

Nia Brooks
Product Lead, Catalyst Health
Attachments: Customer-expected-schema.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Nia Brooks <nia@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:05:23-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation itinerary: streaming -> structured outputs

Hi Nia — really glad Catalyst wants to move forward. I've looped in Monica (CS lead) and Priyom (solutions/infra) to propose a concrete itinerary. First pass below — Monica/Priyom, please confirm owners and adjust dates if needed.

Proposed 6-week itinerary (summary):
1) Week 0 (Aug 16-20): Discovery + schema alignment — review your spreadsheet and produce a canonical JSON schema draft. Owner: Monica.
2) Week 1-2 (Aug 23-Sep 3): Staging integration — streaming endpoint + function-calling hooks for lookup APIs; validate latency and partial updates. Owner: Priyom.
3) Week 3 (Sep 6-10): Schema enforcement & contract tests — add JSON schema validations and CI gating. Owner: Monica + Catalyst eng.
4) Week 4-5 (Sep 13-24): Canary rollout to internal staging, QA, and perf tuning (batching / KV cache). Owner: Priyom.
5) Week 6 (Sep 27-Oct 1): Production cutover checklist & handoff (runbooks, on-call config). Owner: Tessa.

I'll share redwood-streaming-checklist.md and a baseline json-output-examples.json for your test harness. Monica: can you convert Nia's spreadsheet into the canonical schema by EOD Monday (Aug 16)? Priyom: can you confirm whether Catalyst needs any special network peering or VPN for staging? Also flag if SCIM/SSO requires additional time.

I'll tentatively book a 60-min walkthrough for Tue Aug 24, 9:30-10:30am PST; I can move if Tue/Wed morning is a hard constraint on your end.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198
Attachments: redwood-streaming-checklist.md (doc), json-output-examples.json (sample payloads)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-08-16T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation itinerary: streaming -> structured outputs

Tessa / team — I reviewed Nia's spreadsheet and sketched a canonical JSON schema and a set of validation checkpoints. Key items and owners below. See attached sample payloads (json-output-examples.json).

Technical notes / constraints:
- Streaming: we'll implement a partial-result streaming model where each token chunk includes a sequence_id and partial_state. Catalyst should reconcile by sequence_id.
- Function/tool calling: Redwood's function call contract posts to a registered callback URL and expects a 200 within 3000ms. For lookups that exceed that window we'll recommend an async pattern where the tool call returns an immediate ack and posts a follow-up event when data is available.
- Schema: canonical JSON schema will include required/optional fields, strict enums for intent and category, and a top-level "trace_id" for observability.

Action items (owners + dates):
- Monica: Deliver canonical JSON schema v0.1 (Mon Aug 16 EOD) — includes types, required fields, and example enums.
- Priyom: Confirm network requirements & callback test harness (Tue Aug 17).
- Lauren: Prep a short demo that shows streaming partials mapped to UI (Wed Aug 18).
- Catalyst: Provide sample lookup API endpoints and auth method (OAuth client creds) by Wed Aug 18.

Validation checklist (to include in redwood-streaming-checklist.md):
- Schema validation unit tests in CI
- 95th percentile token latency perf targets
- Tool-calling retry/backoff behavior documented

I'll upload the schema draft and payload samples to the shared Drive and tag the HubSpot deal with the milestone.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: json-output-examples.json

From: Nia Brooks <nia@catalysthealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Catalyst Health Platform Team <platform@catalysthealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T08:45:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation itinerary: streaming -> structured outputs

Thanks — and thanks Monica for the breakdown.

A few clarifications before the walkthrough:
- For function/tool-calling auth we prefer OAuth2 client credentials (no mTLS for now). Will that work?
- For schema evolution: would Redwood host the canonical versions, or should Catalyst pin versions on our side?
- Demo: Tue Aug 24 at 9:30am PST works. Please send calendar invite & SSO test instructions for our staging user.

Also, can you surface any perf expectations for token-level latency under typical load (we run about 20 req/s in staging during smoke tests)?

Nia
Catalyst Health Platform Team

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Nia Brooks <nia@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-08-19T16:22:45-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation itinerary: streaming -> structured outputs

Hi Nia — quick answers and next steps.

- OAuth2 client credentials: confirmed. Priyom will share an auth guide and a sample curl for token exchange before the walkthrough.
- Schema hosting: Redwood can host the canonical schema in our internal schema registry and publish a versioned URL; we will also place an artifact in the shared Drive so Catalyst can pin a copy.
- Perf targets: baseline we aim for sub-200ms per token p95 in staging for sequences under 1024 tokens; we'll run perf tests during canary weeks and iterate batching/kv-cache.

Demo confirmed: Tue Aug 24, 9:30-10:30am PST (60 mins). I'll send calendar invite + invite-only Drive folder with artifacts. Links below:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123
- DocuSign prep: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=xyz

Next internal owners check (Mon Aug 23): Monica to finalize schema v0.1; Priyom to validate callback auth and provide sample curl; Lauren to prepare demo slides + recording script.

Thanks all — looking forward.

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198 | tessa@redwood.inference
